# Command 1: Navigate to the project directory
cd /Users/ericmaibach/Documents/repos/Arcadia

# Command 2: Submit the Rust app source to the API with Base64 encoded files
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/submit_app_src \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-d '{
    "spec": {
        "appId": "echo",
        "version": "1.0.0-src",
        "runtime": "wasm",
        "tools": ["echo"],
        "sourceLanguage": "rust",
        "files": [
            {
                "name": "Cargo.toml",
                "content": "W3BhY2thZ2VdCm5hbWUgPSAiZWNobyIKdmVyc2lvbiA9ICIwLjEuMCIKZWRpdGlvbiA9ICIyMDIxIgoKW2xpYl0KY3JhdGUtdHlwZSA9IFsiY2R5bGliIl0KCltkZXBlbmRlbmNpZXNdCgo=",
                "encoding": "base64"
            },
            {
                "name": "src/lib.rs", 
                "content": "",
                "encoding": "base64"
            }
        ]
    }
}'

# Alternative: If you want to generate the Base64 content dynamically
# echo "# Generate Base64 encoded Cargo.toml:"
# base64 -i rustwasmexample/echo/Cargo.toml
# echo "# Generate Base64 encoded src/lib.rs:"
# base64 -i rustwasmexample/echo/src/lib.rs
